headline: Larvotto Gets $30 Million Prepayment for Hillgrove Gold Project
summary: Larvotto Resources secured a US$30 million prepayment agreement from commodities trading firms Glencore and Wogen, shipping its first gold concentrate from the Hillgrove mine in New South Wales.
why: The Hillgrove deposit contains significant antimony and gold reserves. Antimony is a critical mineral utilised in defence, energy storage, and flame-retardant industrial applications.

impacts.name: Larvotto Resources
impacts.why: A US$30 million prepayment facility secures working capital to fund production ramp-up at Hillgrove.
